desc: Ideation complete: f(L,R) equals the number of connected components of distinct values in A[L..R].
Implement the online last-occurrence aggregate method in O(N), updating only the adjacent pairs (x-1,x) and (x,x+1).
Run sample tests and edge cases (N=1, all same, all distinct, boundaries x=1 and x=N) to verify correctness.
Offline inclusion-exclusion fallback is unnecessary because the online method passed all sample tests.
